reviewItem.question: For "fix: Allow Azure CLI calls in `flux push artifact --provider azure` on DevOps runners by @matheuscscp in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5390", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether operators run `flux push artifact --provider azure` from Azure DevOps runners (CLI usage in CI pipelines, not cluster configuration)

proposed.statement: In Flux 2.7.0, `flux push artifact --provider azure` is allowed to call the Azure CLI when it runs on Azure DevOps runners.
